detail_lineage_keys.usage: Trace booking/approval lines to the AB header.
Trace asset-request lines to the AR header.
Trace quotation requests back to the originating asset request.
Trace asset orders back to the originating quotation request.
Trace asset entry/acquisition records back to the originating asset order.
Trace asset-disposal lines to the AG header.
Trace asset-transfer lines to the AT header.
Trace asset-transfer allocation/payment lines to the AT header.
Trace depreciation lines to the DA header.

important_rules: Use header tables for document numbers, dates, statuses, and asset-lifecycle references.
Use detail tables for asset/item rows per procurement or disposal document.
Use asset/category/depreciation masters when the question focuses on fixed-asset setup rather than document flow.
Use history tables only when the user explicitly asks for asset history or audit trails.
Because this domain is asset-heavy, do not assume every M7 table is a generic procurement table.

query_patterns.name: asset_depreciation_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace depreciation setup and depreciation journals.

caution_areas: Questions that mix asset procurement with fixed-asset masters without separating documents from masters.
Questions that rely on the folder name and ignore that the active source is dominated by asset lifecycle.
Questions that use history tables together with active tables without a clear audit purpose.
